description: A DDNet client opens its Hook Collisions settings page, then a player on a flat grass practice level aims the hook collision line around, teleports to a tall grass pillar, to a small block with a second player behind it and next to that second player, and fires the grappling hook several times; near the end a command is typed into the remote console before the player aims and fires again.
reproduces: https://github.com/ddnet/ddnet/issues/10943 (hook collision line problems, including bug item 5: "hook line breaks with some tunings `tune hook_fire_speed 1`") plus the injected hook-line defects of this task
scenario: Real DDNet client + server built from the task image's source (base commit plus the task's injected defects), headless (Xvfb + Mesa llvmpipe, ffmpeg x11grab, 1280x800, 30 fps, 1:02). Settings: always show own hook collision line, own line width 20, opacity 100%, default legend colours. A generated practice map (grass_main / generic_unhookable tiles); the second player is the client's own dummy. Beats: settings page (0:00-0:04); aim swept from right over the top to the left onto an unhookable block, hook fired at it (0:04-0:17); in front of a tall grass pillar 12 tiles away, hook fired twice, then 11 tiles away, hook fired once (0:17-0:29); left of a one-tile block with the dummy right behind it, hook fired (0:29-0:36); right of the dummy, aiming at it and then slightly higher, hook fired (0:36-0:44); remote console `tune hook_fire_speed 0.9` (0:44-0:50); aim swept and hook fired after respawning (0:50-1:02).
